name: emplio-desktop
description: Emplio on your Mac or PC: the same app, plus your own computer and browser for Emplio to work on while it's awake.

scripts.dmg: npm run pack && sh build/make-dmg.sh out/Emplio-darwin-universal/Emplio.app
scripts.dmg:older: npm run pack:older && sh build/make-dmg.sh out/older/Emplio-darwin-universal/Emplio.app older
scripts.linux: npm run pack:linux && cp build/linux/emplio out/Emplio-linux-x64/emplio && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar -C out --no-xattrs --no-mac-metadata --exclude='._*' -czf out/Emplio-linux-x64.tar.gz Emplio-linux-x64
